title: fisc graph projection
description: One document internal/project builds as a graph: the citywide spine and the four schedules drawn beside it. It is a Go-to-Go contract rather than a published one -- internal/export folds these into one file per column and a reader fetches the column -- and it is a schema because the two packages are otherwise coupled by json tags alone. internal/export decodes it without importing internal/project, so a tag renamed on either side reads as a zero value with no error anywhere.

projection.description: A DECLARED SET AND NOT AN OPEN ONE: internal/project names each of these in a constant that pkg/cmd/export's step declarations read, so the enum is what makes those copies one claim.

headline.description: The spine's own figures. Their keys mean nothing on any other schedule, which is why no other document carries the block at all rather than carrying it zeroed. A DECLARED SET AND NOT AN OPEN ONE -- internal/check reads these names to reconcile the published totals against the facts, so an open map would let a renamed key pass here and fail there.

counts.description: How much of the corpus this document accounts for. facts minus facts_cited is the part of the schedule the chart cannot show -- zero-valued cells and stock rows -- and stating both is what makes that gap a quantity a check can assert.

allOf.description: ONE SCHEDULE OR SEVERAL, NAMED EITHER WAY AND NEVER BOTH. Envelope.Scope is singular because a document carrying one is of exactly one schedule; fund-flows is built over two, so it states `scopes` and no `scope` rather than writing one of them into a singular key. This is the claim the fenced block in docs/sankey-contract.md could not make.

nodes.description: EMPTY IS A DOCUMENT AND NOT AN ERROR: a projection built over facts that select nothing publishes an empty graph rather than refusing, and internal/export skips such a document when folding columns. What is refused is a null -- every key present on every object, no omitempty anywhere.

value_cents.description: Integer cents as the document printed it, signed: a contra row -- a reduction the schedule prints in parentheses -- arrives negative.

allOf.description: A published link cites at least one fact and names where it was read; a derived one cites nothing, because no page prints it.

A DOCUMENT THAT DRAWS SOMETHING SAYS WHERE IT READ IT. An empty projection -- built over facts that select nothing -- publishes an empty graph and cites nothing, which is honest; a projection with nodes and no sources is a chart with no provenance, which is the one thing this project cannot ship. So the floor is conditional rather than absent.
THE HEADLINE IS THE SPINE'S ALONE. Its keys are all_funds_gross_* and naive_expenditure_cents, which are claims about the citywide totals and mean nothing on a schedule drawn over part of the city.
